name: 3DO ApS
summary: Danish 3D-printing webshop in Herning (3DO ApS, CVR 45698831, successor to a 2021 sole proprietorship) selling printers, parts and own-label PLA, PETG, ASA and fibre-filled ASA. The extruder behind the filament is not identified.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: 1 kg, 1.75 mm; SpoolmanDB records a 220 g spool.

product_lines.name: ASA
product_lines.notes: Praised by Filament Cheat Sheet citing a MyTechFun test (original not verified).

additional_notes: Registered at Godsbanevej 7, 7400 Herning; the 3do.dk footer shows 3DO ApS at the same address. Predecessor sole proprietorship '3DO' (CVR 42459852) ran 2021-06 to 2026-03-30. A colour-matched ASA collaboration with Rat Rig is claimed by a single aggregator (Filament Cheat Sheet) - rumoured, uncorroborated, not encoded. Not generally sold on Amazon. Price ~$22-35/kg per Filament Cheat Sheet (secondary).

provenance.conflicts: Identity and HQ solid; filament manufacturer and manufacturing country unknown. Rat Rig collaboration and ASA-CF/GF lines single-sourced to an aggregator.
